na763415b07.headline: NSE All-Share Index inches 31,000 mark, amid massive gains
na763415b07.summary: Nigeria's NSE All-Share Index rose by 3.49% to close at 31,000 points, reaching a 21-month high with market capitalization increasing by 366 billion naira.
na763415b07.why: The Nigerian stock market's strong performance reflects investor confidence and economic activity in Africa's largest economy.

source.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

sources.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

na763415b07.why_moved: Investor optimism and positive market momentum drove the Nigerian stock market to a 21-month peak.
